# Trading USD/INR
This tutorial will break down key insights needed to speculate on the USD/INR, including the benefits of live trading the dollar against the rupee, economic factors to consider, how to measure exchange rate value, reading candlestick charts, and more. We have also listed the top supporting brokers.

...

## USD/INR Meaning
The USD/INR currency pair is simply the value of the US dollar against the Indian rupee. The forex pair tells the trader how many rupees (the quote currency) are needed to purchase one dollar (the base currency).

...

## Why USD Is Stronger Than INR
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) also often buys US dollars from the market. This causes a rise in rupee liquidity. The increase in the supply of rupee without a corresponding demand then makes the rupee depreciate further against the dollar.
That said, there have been times when the strength of the USD/INR has switched. In the past, a record inflow of dollars through Foreign Portfolio Inflows (FPI) and other modes have increased the demand for the rupee. This has led to the rupee rising against the US dollar.
